description: Classement sonore du réseau ferroviaire du département du Doubs is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Direction Départementale des Territoires du Doubs. The sound classification of railway tracks determines a band on either side of the track, within which the buildings to be built must be subjected to special acoustic isolation measures. Sound classification of the rail network of DoubsNRESEAURFCLT2021L025.shp. Coverage: Direction Départementale des Territoires du Doubs. The portal shows the English title as "Sound classification of the rail network of the Doubs department" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Direction Départementale des Territoires du Doubs. Its keywords include bruit, nuisance, ddt-doubs, ddt-25, ferroviaire. The listing shows 2 download or service links in ODT, SHP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
